data.one_liner: An explicit acyclic step dependency framework with concurrent evaluation and dependency injection.
data.what_it_does: Defines steps with acyclic dependencies on other steps, evaluating them concurrently and caching results in a Runner object. It allows overriding steps to inject values or mocks for testing.
use_when: You need to initialize complex projects or servers with multiple interdependent components.
You want to evaluate complex task graphs where tasks depend on previous results.
You need to easily override dependencies or mock values during testing.
avoid_when: You are looking for a standard widget tree state management solution.
You need a general-purpose service locator without task graph evaluation.
strengths: Concurrent evaluation of steps based on dependency constraints.
Built-in support for overriding steps with mock values during testing.
weaknesses: Niche framework with relatively low adoption compared to standard DI packages.

alternatives.name: get_it
alternatives.why_pick_it: More widely used service locator for Flutter and Dart dependency injection.

alternatives.name: injectable
alternatives.why_pick_it: Code-generation based dependency injection built on top of get_it.
